name: Flaming Sphere
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Choose an unoccupied space within medium range. A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears there. Roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

You may spend a half action to move the sphere up to your speed. If you ram the sphere into a creature, it stops and cannot move further this turn.

Any creature that comes into contact with the sphere or ends its turn adjacent to it must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a failure, the creature takes 2d6 damage. On a pass, half damage.

When you move the sphere, you can direct it over barriers up to 5 ft tall and across gaps up to 10 ft wide. The sphere ignites flammable objects not being worn or carried, and it sheds light out to medium range.

Describe the sphere.
successes:
✨: Once per round, when the sphere deals damage, you may choose to add +1d to the damage roll.

🌞: The sphere increases to 10 ft in diameter, it's speed increases by 10 ft, and it deals +2d damage.
